actions.action: Get a very sharp pair of scissors or knife for pruning
Cut overly tall or wide leaves at an angle where the stem attaches to the main stem
Remove dry parts to make the plant look cleaner
Cut damaged or old leaves as close to the soil level as possible
Cover each cut with a bit of soil

verdict.reason: The video is about pruning damaged and unwanted bird of paradise leaves, which matches the confirmed need to cut old, damaged lower leaves; its main advice is to cut them at the base, the fix the poster used, and nothing in it is harmful (it does omit the repotting suggestion).
